newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SGB share discount should be 10/15 pct.
newsitem.headline: SGB share discount should be 10/15 pct.

text.p: Chairman Etienne Davignon of Belgian holding company Societe Generale de Belgique SA (SGB) told a news conference on Wednesday a market discount of its shares of between 10 and 15 percent would be logical.
SGB said the net asset value per share was 3,814 francs on February 28, up from 3,443 francs at the end of 1996 and 2,998 at the end of 1995.
SGB shares closed at 2,805 francs on the Brussels bourse on Wednesday.
SGB said earlier on Wednesday the current discount on its share price was not justified.

"In view of the steady increase in profits over the past five years, the prospects of future profits based on a clear strategy, the stature of the group's managers and the refocusing of the portfolio on the key particiapting interests, the SGB ordinary share should not be trading at the current market discount," SGB said in a statement.
